name: Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Antai IMBA)

class_size.note: No IMBA class profile found on the English site.

tuition_total.note: 'The tuition fee for 2025 IMBA program (2 years) is 368,000 RMB', two annual instalments. Same figure on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/admissions/faqs.html. No 2026/2027 figure published yet.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No other mandatory fee listed. Application fee RMB 800 or USD 120.

components.item: single bedroom in shared off-campus apartment

living_budget_total.note: No total budget published; ranges only. The FAQ page (https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/admissions/faqs.html) says rent about RMB 4,000/month and 'budgeting 8,000/month (outside of rent)', which differs from the fee page (4,000-5,000).

scholarship.note: GMAT 730+ (Focus 675+): 50% of tuition; 680+ (625+): 25%; 630+ (585+): RMB 50,000. Interview ranking: 1st 50%, 2nd-4th 25%, 5th-13th RMB 50,000. Early Bird RMB 10,000 (top 5 of rounds 1-2). CFA RMB 5,000-15,000. Performance-based partial scholarships for 'almost 30%' (IMBA microsite) or 'almost 20%' (FAQ) of MBA students: inconsistent.

employment.cohort: Class of 2016 (latest IMBA report on the site)

base_salary.note: No salary published by the school.

employment.notes: Data are for 2016 IMBA graduates (too old for the site's current figures; kept for reference only). Employer type 2016: state-owned 40%, foreign-funded 28%, NGO/private holding 9%. A 2024 news item (https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/news/84964.html) on the 2023 full-time MBA report gives only 2.5 job opportunities per capita and 'highest salary growth rate 166.7%', no salary level.

profile.note: No class profile published. Minimums: GMAT 550+, two years' work experience.

notes: Not found in FT Global MBA 2026 (school news cites FT MiM 2026 rank 3, not the MBA; ClearAdmit's FT 2026 MBA table does not list Antai). The school cites 'ranked 34th ... by the Financial Times' in 2018. No current employment report or salary: no ROI possible; keep cost-only profile or drop from the 75.
